I write in response to your letters dated 26 and 27 October 2023 and enclosed
material.
-->,

I am sorry to hear of your experiences as a victim of sexual abuse. Your commitment
to use your personal experiences to help others is commendable.
Please note that as Attorney-General, I am unable to provide legal advice and am
therefore unable to provide assistance to you or meet with you.
The Legal Services Commission of South Australia provides a free advisory service
on most legal matters. The advisory service is available by calling 1300 366 424, or
you can chat online with their lawyers during business hours by clicking the Legal
Chat icon at the following website: https://lsc.samov.au/.
JusticeNet SA also undertakes pro bono work in South Australia for eligible
individuals that are ineligible for assistance from existing legal services and are
unable to afford a private solicitor or barrister. To qualify for assistance from
JusticeNet SA, applicants must satisfy eligibility criteria, including a means and merits
test. Further information is available at htto://www.justicenetorq.au. I have also
enclosed a fact sheet with further Legal Services that may be available.
I trust this information assists and wish you all the best with your future endeavours.
Yours sincerely

Hon Kyam Maher MLC
Attorney-General
